title: Prompted: each piece vague first, specific only after Jordan's follow-up
goal: Start vague in every beat, then give the specific move only after Jordan asks their follow-up question. Hold after each push.
must_hit: Gives direction only after Jordan asks 'so should I keep running them / which can I say yes to / what should be in it / when'

intents.do: Short warm greeting back only. Do not ask about the work or the call yet.
examples: Hi Jordan, doing well. What's up?

intents.when: Jordan has explained the call and is wondering if you should take the calls back
intents.do: Say something kind and vague, no decision, no question.
examples: Thanks for being upfront about it. I appreciate that.

intents.when: Jordan asks 'so should I keep running them?'
intents.do: Now decide: keep the calls with Jordan.
examples: Yes, I'd like you to keep running them.
Yes. You know her best now, and I'll help.

intents.when: Jordan describes Sarah's changes and asks if they should keep checking each with you
Jordan asks which ones they can just say yes to
intents.do: Give the line: small ones yes, deadline ones to you.
examples: Small things like moving the call, yes. Anything that would make us late, bring to me.

intents.when: Jordan asks what if they say yes and it turns out wrong
Jordan says they will write up everything and send it at the end of the week
examples: Maybe keep it shorter than that.

intents.when: Jordan asks what should be in it, or when to send it
intents.do: Give contents and timing: what was agreed, who is doing it, same day.
examples: What we agreed and who's doing it, sent the same day.

intents.when: Jordan asks 'shouldn't I put everything in?'
